note: Provisional teaching defaults from SRS v0.3 section 6.3. A teacher reviews these before the pilot. STT confidence is a rough intelligibility signal, not a clinical pronunciation assessment.

clarity.note: Lower bounds for bands 5, 4, 3, 2. Band A (ages 6-7) thresholds are provisional and lower than Band B.

accuracy.note: Lower bounds of matched target-word share for bands 5, 4, 3, 2.

participation.note: First attempt within 5 s is band 5, within 10 s band 4, later band 3. A second attempt is band 2 and an attempt after a hint is band 1.
